introduction.definition: Laser alignment equipment measures shaft misalignment with two units, each with a laser and a position-sensitive detector, clamped to the two shafts. Turning the shafts together moves the beam spots; the display computes offset and angularity and gives shim and move values for each foot of the movable machine.
applications: Precision alignment of pumps, motors, fans, gearboxes, compressors
introduction.summary: Laser alignment equipment uses laser transmitters and position detectors clamped to each shaft to measure misalignment precisely and calculate the shim and horizontal corrections for the movable machine.

pressure.title: The beam spot reveals misalignment
pressure.description: Each unit projects a laser onto the opposite unit's position detector (PSD). As both shafts are turned together through at least ≈ 70–140° (e.g. 9-12-3 o'clock), the spot traces a path whose movement gives offset and angularity in both planes. The display calculates shim values and horizontal moves for each motor foot and can update live while moving. Advantages over dial indicators: no bracket sag, higher resolution (≈ 1 µm), faster. Check soft foot first and apply thermal-growth targets.

video_tutorials.title: Laser Alignment Equipment — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Laser Alignment Equipment.
Laser alignment equipment measures shaft misalignment with two units, each with a laser and a position-sensitive detector, clamped to the two shafts.
Turning the shafts together moves the beam spots; the display computes offset and angularity and gives shim and move values for each foot of the movable machine.
Typical applications include precision alignment of pumps, motors, fans, gearboxes, compressors; machine-train alignment and thermal-growth checks.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Laser Alignment Equipment works.
Mount S- and M-units on the shafts.
Laser beams strike the detectors.
Rotate shafts 9–12–3 o'clock.
The display gives corrections.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Each unit projects a laser onto the opposite unit's position detector (PSD).

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Laser Alignment Equipment.
Charge batteries; clean optics.
Check calibration certificate.
Send for recalibration.
Watch for unstable readings: values drift. Common cause: air turbulence / heat, loose brackets.
Watch for beam off detector: out of range. Common cause: large misalignment.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
